status: Scenario specifications only; not executable vectors or recorded passing tests.

fixture_conventions.basic_fact: height=42; later height=87; explicit timestamps/validity per case
fixture_conventions.schema: Existing generic mask(drop) -> select(root) -> group(byTargetContext), resolved by pick(byTimestamp desc) with existing tie rules. Use existing SPEC-3 publishers for definition acts.
fixture_conventions.expected_bytes: M0/M1 implementation work must materialize concrete canonical fixtures; scenario prose and prior draft examples are not those fixtures.

evidence_rule: A milestone is complete only when each applicable scenario has concrete evidence in both required witnesses, or the declared checker/review evidence kind. No scenario is marked passed by this planning artifact.

scenarios.setup_and_action: All native interpretation stages and public semantic exports are enumerated.
scenarios.expected: Every entry has an owner, downward binding, upward affordance and explicit intrinsic/capability/native-extension classification; portable execution uses no unclassified policy.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use current TS source graph and Rust modules, including shared types.rs and reexports.
scenarios.expected: Each semantic owner and cross-owner dependency is mapped; all 12 current packages plus two planned boundaries have cards; compatibility exports are not mistaken for semantic owners.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Existing witness manifests include L0 and L4 witnesses.
scenarios.expected: New profile capability is explicit and separate from level; TS/Rust are required; lower-level witnesses are preserved and do not falsely claim intake support.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Remove or rename a required scenario result from one witness report.
scenarios.expected: CI fails even if all remaining tests pass; skip/xfail/empty discovery cannot count as coverage.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Inject lower-to-command import, type-only upward edge, aggregate self-import, dynamic literal import and an unmapped external dependency in disposable fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Checker rejects each independently; it does not silently omit unsupported import forms.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Add an exported semantic callback/API without a contract classification.
scenarios.expected: Contract inventory checker fails; declaring it native-only cannot allow its undeclared use in a portable profile.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Construct configuration, both operation declarations, retain/evaluate requests and each outcome status with fixed fixtures.
scenarios.expected: Both witnesses construct equal canonical claims/IDs/signatures and decode/re-encode identically without installation or execution.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Independently omit each required role; duplicate a singleton or repeated set member; add unknown roles, kinds, contexts and enum values.
scenarios.expected: Pure readers reject each malformed description; runtime maps the appropriate common or operation-specific category without native exception text.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Supply repeatable refs/keys in several input orders to writers.
scenarios.expected: Writers use specified table and UTF-8 order; readers accept pointer permutations but preserve original signed IDs.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use strings, finite numeric edge cases, booleans, nested arrays/maps, empty collections and nested bytes leaves.
scenarios.expected: Strict View decoder preserves every typed value and reproduces existing canonical bytes in TS/Rust.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Compare object {mime: text, value: text} with bytes leaf {mime: text, value: bstr}; include reserved-looking property names.
scenarios.expected: Readers distinguish them, handle keys as data and preserve both byte encodings; JSON debug rendering is not used as the decoder.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Try null, noncanonical numeric encoding, duplicate keys, malformed bytes leaves, unsupported CBOR values and trailing bytes.
scenarios.expected: Strict reader rejects all; negative zero follows existing canonicalization rather than an invented numeric rule.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Change status/body combinations, add head to catalog evaluate, omit required fields, insert unsorted/overlapping retain result IDs or unknown codes.
scenarios.expected: Reader rejects illegal combinations and validates nested View bytes; refused/indeterminate cannot masquerade as completed admissions.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Encode empty and nonempty canonical primitive bindings; use null, array, duplicate key, root variable or noncanonical bytes.
scenarios.expected: Legal bindings round-trip; malformed bindings and reserved root collision are refused.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Boot with a peer-signed configuration, two peer-signed operation declarations and allowed caller set.
scenarios.expected: Endpoint uses exact selected configuration; boot rejects wrong peer/signers, missing/duplicate operation kinds or invalid declaration effect/handler/replay combinations.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Caller supplies or retains a signed replacement configuration or operation declaration.
scenarios.expected: Stored description stays inert; supplied but unreferenced descriptions are unexpected-support; selected runtime configuration/catalog do not change.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use valid requests signed by allowed and disallowed keys, wrong receiver, wrong config ID and an expired config/declaration.
scenarios.expected: Only allowed caller under matching valid configuration executes; failures use unauthorized or configuration-mismatch; a prior success does not bypass checks.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use before validFrom, exactly validFrom, just before validUntil and exactly validUntil; retry after expiry.
scenarios.expected: Half-open validity is enforced at receivedAt, including repeated request IDs; historical evaluation at does not change it.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Deliver two request-shaped deltas, but name only one as entry and the other as its payload.
scenarios.expected: Only the addressed root invokes; missing canonical root gives entry-missing; malformed entryId is a local transport error.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Offer valid and invalid appearances with the same ID, including an already admitted ID, in both orders.
scenarios.expected: Entire delivery is invalid-appearance before any effect; deduplication cannot hide invalid bytes or signatures.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Repeat a byte-identical valid supplied delta while naming it once as support.
scenarios.expected: One support object after validation; every appearance counts toward limits; duplicate request payload pointers remain malformed.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Reach and exceed count/byte limits with duplicate appearances; combine a determinable exceeded limit with invalid signature.
scenarios.expected: At-limit valid input proceeds; over-limit returns resource-limit before handler invocation and signature diagnostics.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Mutate caller-owned native objects during an awaited store operation after submitting a request.
scenarios.expected: The captured verified invocation/payload retains its original meaning or mutation is rejected; no unchecked changed content commits.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Omit named payload/definition; add an unrelated valid delta; reference an absent ordinary entity from inside payload.
scenarios.expected: Missing support and extraneous support refuse; unresolved ordinary data references do not trigger implicit dependency fetching.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Permute appearances without changing signed request/definitions, source, receiver key or observations.
scenarios.expected: Canonical result and response are equal for each permutation; changing signed pointer order is tested by semantic comparison with request IDs accounted for.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Retain one foreign-authored signed fact with request authored by an allowed different key.
scenarios.expected: Only payload commits; original author/claims/ID/signature survive; request and response are not admitted; one durable arrival records unattributed origin.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Retain a request, function/binding description, signed manifest-shaped testimony and erasure-shaped testimony as ordinary payload.
scenarios.expected: Only retain dispatch occurs; no nested invocation, installation, bundle authorization or physical erasure; already refused payload IDs still cannot re-enter.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Name unsigned payload, including a purported member of a valid signed manifest.
scenarios.expected: Delivery refuses; request/manifest signatures do not authorize unsigned members in this profile.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Two fresh IDs exceed remaining declared quota; mix duplicates and fresh IDs; include competing negation closure.
scenarios.expected: Existing quota/closure planner rules apply; a rejected atomic offer commits no fresh IDs and reports no prospective admitted IDs as completed.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Repeat a completed retain against unchanged admitted membership, including after journal reopen.
scenarios.expected: Duplicate-only completion adds no frame/arrival and returns duplicate IDs; it is not the cached original response.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use existing peer operations to establish permanent refusal, then retain the same signed payload.
scenarios.expected: Atomic offer is refused; an earlier command success or negated erasure testimony cannot restore it.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Retain at matching expected-head; then retry with that prior head after state changes.
scenarios.expected: First can commit under CAS; later attempt refuses precondition-failed without a silent retry against new state.

scenarios.setup_and_action: External writer wins between captured state and compare-and-append.
scenarios.expected: Current attempt returns write-conflict without claiming its payload committed; facade is reopened before a later attempt.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Terminate the executor before atomic append; reopen and retry.
scenarios.expected: No partial membership/frame/arrival from the interrupted attempt; retry can commit normally.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Durable append succeeds; terminate before signing/delivering response; reopen and retry.
scenarios.expected: Payload remains admitted with original arrival; retry returns duplicates, not an invented durable response-cache record.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Inject storage acknowledgment uncertainty both when the append persisted and when it did not.
scenarios.expected: Outcome is indeterminate commit-unconfirmed; reopen establishes actual state; no known-refusal or premature success claim.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Fail signer or transport after confirmed append.
scenarios.expected: No rollback or false refusal; caller may receive no outcome; a fresh attempt follows ordinary journal duplicate rules.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Boot on rows without a peer journal.
scenarios.expected: Existing refusal remains; no raw-row import or fabricated arrival history.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Offer a mixture of fresh/duplicate payload with fixed before state and time.
scenarios.expected: Completed result arrays form the sorted disjoint offered-ID partition and before/after heads/digests match verified journal states.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Evaluate a supplied gather/Schema over height=42 without admitting those definitions.
scenarios.expected: Result is height=42; requests/definitions/outcomes remain unpersisted; journal, arrivals and active registrations are unchanged.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use ordinary generic gather/resolve over the installed catalog, also after retaining a lookalike operation declaration.
scenarios.expected: Queries recover installed contracts and configuration; retained lookalike does not enter catalog; no special discovery endpoint needed.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Make the admitted peer store unavailable while a valid installed catalog is present.
scenarios.expected: Catalog query can still complete; admitted query refuses source-unavailable; expected-head on catalog is invalid-arguments.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use a second process/facade to exclude an admitted row, then query through the first endpoint.
scenarios.expected: Query captures current journal-authorized membership; no stale reactor/raw row appears; source digest/head correspond to one verified basis.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Change head between bracketed state/row capture checks.
scenarios.expected: Attempt refuses source-changed; no mixed snapshot or hidden retry is used.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Commit another write after a successful read capture but before evaluation response.
scenarios.expected: Reading consistently uses its captured basis; response names that basis rather than the later head.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Journal admits a row whose physical payload is missing or corrupt.
scenarios.expected: Admitted-source query refuses source-unavailable; it never returns a complete-looking answer over only available rows.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Retain height=42 at H, then query with expected-head=H; repeat with an intervening write/rebase.
scenarios.expected: Without intervention query reads committed value; with changed head it refuses precondition-failed; no local predecessor receipt cache is required.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use correct and incorrect delta-membership/1 digest for admitted and catalog sources.
scenarios.expected: Correct digest proceeds; mismatch refuses; a correct membership digest does not excuse invalid source signatures.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Execute same query ID without head/digest precondition, admit a newer fact, then execute again at same explicit at.
scenarios.expected: Second result reflects new captured source; response digest changes; no cached success answer is used.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Fact valid in [50,100); evaluate at 49,50,99,100 while receivedAt is fixed at 1000.
scenarios.expected: Visibility follows requested evaluation time and half-open bounds; request validity/response time/arrival clock still use receivedAt.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Persist a newer conflicting definition at the same entity while the request selects an older valid signed act and its pin.
scenarios.expected: Execution uses the selected act, not ambient latest; foreign definition authorship survives and grants no unrelated authority.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Supply valid canonical definition act with a request pin for different canonical content.
scenarios.expected: Refuse pin-mismatch before evaluation; no rewriting to match the requested hash.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Supply unsupported alg, missing/extra definition fields, noncanonical blob, invalid-at-evaluation definition or wrong top sort.
scenarios.expected: Stable invalid-definition/invalid-program category as specified; no first-field-wins ambiguity or assumed current version.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Supply two distinct selected acts with the same name, including equal-content duplicate publications; permute delivery.
scenarios.expected: Refuse ambiguous-definition consistently; distinct names sharing content remain legal where existing registry rules permit.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use two-level expansion via named and pinned refs; omit an inner gather/Schema; add unreachable extra definition.
scenarios.expected: Complete closure resolves identically; omitted and extra dependencies refuse definition-closure; no ambient global registry lookup.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Supply an otherwise closed cyclic program-reference graph and a separate data graph with cycles.
scenarios.expected: Program cycle is definition-cycle; data cycles retain existing supported semantics and are not confused with program dependency cycles.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Place references and actsFor inside inView predicates, order predicates, embedded resolution Schemas and expanded child definitions.
scenarios.expected: Discovery/validation/lowering visits all executable positions; no native unbound dependency or principal predicate escapes the selected profile.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Evaluate with explicit variables, absent required variable, and an attempted root override.
scenarios.expected: Bound evaluation is reproducible; missing variable is invalid-program; root override is invalid-arguments.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use core/1 for a program closure containing actsFor, including top resolution order and nested child Schema.
scenarios.expected: Refuse invalid-program rather than privately choosing a principal resolver.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Same explicit evidence set with root-authored negation of another author evidence under both supported suppression policies.
scenarios.expected: Both witnesses agree with current SPEC-14 semantics and produce the independently established different results; at and now both equal request at.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Lower a referenced program using captured source, with conflicting ambient principal evidence and ordinary literal-author predicates.
scenarios.expected: Original canonical pins remain identity; ambient evidence is ignored; ordinary predicates keep standard meaning; named principal interpretation is recorded.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Read a completed bytes-valued evaluation outcome with the originating request/config/definitions.
scenarios.expected: Verify receiver attribution and reconstruct value/context exactly; output does not claim to be the original authors fact; invalid nested View bytes refuse.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Execute with a fixed captured source/config/time while varying process clocks, environment, cache order and unrelated host state.
scenarios.expected: Pure interpretation stays equal; instrumented core performs no extra clock/network/store reads. Host resource exhaustion can refuse explicitly but not change a successful answer.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Combine faults across validation stages and permute multiple failures within a stage.
scenarios.expected: Documented earliest category is stable; source precondition is checked before program validation; no enumeration-dependent native text enters outcomes.

scenarios.setup_and_action: TS produces actual serialized configuration/request/support deltas; Rust executes; TS verifies and reads response.
scenarios.expected: Retain/evaluate, catalog, nested closure, principal profile, bytes and refusal cases pass with no shared native fixtures.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Reverse construction/execution/readback roles using the same profile.
scenarios.expected: Equivalent semantics and canonical bytes under equal explicit context; signed attribution is checked rather than erased for comparison.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Two valid receivers with distinct keys execute equivalent authorized requests over equivalent inputs.
scenarios.expected: Compare validated semantic value and context mapping; do not require equality of distinct receiver/request/config signatures or IDs.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Run all existing witness gates, canonical shared vectors, docs/vector freshness and relevant WASM build.
scenarios.expected: No existing canonical bytes or lower-level witness capability changes silently; failures cannot be waived by new intake success.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Inspect CI and run required fault/coverage/mixed-witness jobs on the exact candidate head.
scenarios.expected: Crash and retry scenarios actually execute; result artifacts include head/toolchain/witness/profile and exact passed scenario IDs; TODOs are not passing evidence.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Independent reviewer inspects frozen head and source-based contracts without adopting builder conclusions.
scenarios.expected: Review assesses bootstrap sufficiency, hidden policy, portability classifications, duplication and remaining gaps; clean result states scope and limits.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Describe each tower stage, semantic owners, effect class, portable port versions and required capabilities; identify unsplit command execution.
scenarios.expected: Every crossed edge has a reconstructible contract; deferred HView/registry/etc. ports are reported as gaps, not private serialized native objects.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use fixed planner seeds and capability manifests, including a fixture with only one or two distinct eligible mixed assignments.
scenarios.expected: Planner produces reproducible concrete graphs; three runs prefer distinct plans, explicitly report repeats when necessary, and include a language switch whenever supported.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Advertise only L0 for a witness, remove an execution port capability, or insert a boundary lacking lossless encoding.
scenarios.expected: Ineligible assignment is rejected; missing required mixed route fails CI; no same-language fallback, inferred L4/intake support or silently omitted stage.

scenarios.setup_and_action: For each selected scenario run three eligible seeded language assignments with the same fixture and observations.
scenarios.expected: Each result matches the fixed oracle and compatible intermediate artifacts match their contracts; exercised edges and unsplit regions are reported.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Use a retain/query scenario where sharing state would make later towers see duplicate admissions rather than the same fresh admission.
scenarios.expected: Every tower starts from an isolated identical initial journal/state; all observe the specified admissions and arrivals, with no cache/registration/state leakage.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Capture a failing concrete plan, then change the default planner seed or available capability manifest.
scenarios.expected: Replay uses retained plan/builds/artifacts and reproduces the failure without rerolling; unavailable pinned build fails clearly rather than substituting newer code.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Make all three test adapters return the same incorrect canonical result.
scenarios.expected: Gate fails against the independently specified expected outcome; agreement alone cannot pass.

scenarios.setup_and_action: Corrupt one intermediate serialized artifact or drop a required context/definition reference.
scenarios.expected: Contract validation identifies the failing producer/consumer stage and stores the exact plan/input/output; a private shared registry cannot repair the missing input.
